build_PLRRunner: build a PLRRunner instance with replay probability, buffer size, staleness coefficient, and mutation settings for curriculum learning
run_PLRRunner: run the PLRRunner main training loop that samples levels, evaluates agents, performs gradient updates, and mutates levels
review_MutationCriterion: review the MutationCriterion enum with BATCH, EASY, and HARD options for selecting which levels to mutate
test_eval_and_update_plr: test the _eval_and_update_plr method that performs student rollouts and updates the PLR buffer with UED scores
